items.title: Locally of finite type morphisms are etale-locally finite over smooth maps with geometrically integral fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The local-local structure theorem: for f : X -> S locally of finite type and x over s with n equal to the local fibre dimension dim_x(X_s), there is a diagram with an elementary etale neighbourhood g : (X', x') -> (X, x), a second elementary etale neighbourhood e : (S', s') -> (S, s), a smooth map h : Y' -> S' of relative dimension n with geometrically integral fibres, and a finite map pi : X' -> Y' sending x' to y' with pi^{-1}(y') = {x'} and kappa(y') purely transcendental over kappa(s'); for finite presentation f the map pi can be taken of finite presentation. The retained proof reduces to S affine, applies the chapter's local structure lemma to obtain a smooth Y -> S with purely transcendental residue extension at y, uses etale-locality on X, builds an elementary etale neighbourhood whose pullback open Y' has geometrically irreducible fibres identifying the fibre with a prescribed affine space piece, selects the canonical points (x', s') and (y, s') above the originals, and verifies the outer rectangle satisfies all six listed properties; the author marks some minor details omitted inside this fully written construction. Retained author proof at lines 13462-13520.
